law_name: Copyright Act, Chapter 13.07 (Act No. 10 of 1995, as amended by Act No. 7 of 2000), 2015 Revised Edition
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (end of calendar year of death, s. 9(1)); unknown authorship 50 years from first availability to the public (s. 9(2))
moral_rights: Moral rights recognized (ss. 14-18): attribution, integrity and related rights last as long as copyright; right against false attribution (s. 16) lasts 20 years after death (s. 18)
registration_required: No (registration only of collecting societies under 2000 amendment; unconfirmed)
notes: In force 1 Oct 1996. Berne since 24 Aug 1993, WTO 1 Jan 1995; Commons also lists a WIPO treaty on 6 Mar 2002 without naming WCT or WPPT. 2000 amendment added collective societies and performers' moral rights. Section 16 is cited as the 20-year right in search summary; check numbering.
